vapt.name: VAPT — native scanner
vapt.description: Performance plus Vaptr, the self-contained native scanner. Fingerprint, crawl, content/parameter discovery and vulnerability checks all run in-process; no external tools (httpx/katana/nuclei/ffuf) are bundled, so it runs inside the v86 guest.
